event_type.meaning: a message's delivery status, hold or acknowledgement changed
a session registered or registered again
a session's state or retirement changed

session_state.meaning: the session waits for a permission prompt
the session is working on a turn
the session ended its turn and can take work; not a claim that a task is done
the session ended or was retired; it gets no more messages

event_cause.meaning: a cleanup step (for example prune) changed the session
the client asked the owner for a permission
a new prompt started a turn
the state was repaired after a crash
the client reported that the session ended

delivery_status.meaning: delivery started; the result is not known yet
the delivery command failed; the message was not delivered
the message was put into the session's hook context; not proof that it was read
the message was refused before it was sent; final
the session waits for an approval, so the message is held or refused
the message waits for the session's next activity
a reply value only; never stored and never in an event
the transport accepted the message; not read, not acted on
written to the session's transport; not read, not acted on
the transport timed out; the message may or may not have arrived
the write ended without a clear result; the message may or may not have arrived
a wake hint was tried; it is not known whether it arrived
a wake hint was written for the session

message_kind.meaning: an automatic completion notice, not a message an agent wrote
